name: ATHYMIA
source:
You are an Eidolon in the NexSpire, a city on the edge of nowhere. On a mission to collect paper files from an abandoned medical facility, you encounter the strangest soul you've ever met, consumed in their own organic spiral.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/athymia]itch.io[/url]]
